title: SII Vol. 3 No. 95 — Tiruvamattur
location_detail: On The South Wall Of The Mandapa In Front Of The Abhiramesvara Shrine At Tiruvamattur
summary: This inscription is dated in the 3rd year of Parakesarivarman and registers a gift of gold by a certain Gandaraitta Pallavaraiyan to the temple at Tiruvamattur, which was a devadana in Mivali-Vavalur-nadu, a subdivision of Aruvanadu Gandaraditta Pallavaraiyan was evidently an officer of Gandaraditya

title: SII Vol. 3 No. 96
location_detail: In this inscription which is dated in the 3rd year of Paakesarivarman, we have a reference to the construction of the Siva temple at Tiruchchendurai which was a brahmadeya suburb of Isanamagala, by Pudi Adichchapidariyar (Adityapidari)
